comments.author: Holfina
comments.body:
this is not a casting skill but a casting assistance, meaning the production window can be minimized for casting while sailing so you can have a full view of the sea . Victor has casting assistance (less vigour consumed, instead of 5 it becomes 4 per prod) and has the casting skill which gives +1. :)

Chester is mainly used by players for sb so they can attain r20 w/ items of course. Cheers...
